reuse.why: linkFintegraAccount uses the tree's shared assertBankAccountNotLinked, link.findOrCreateBank and linkAccountAndSync exactly as the other providers do, and the sync dispatch reuses post/BankSyncError/BankSyncResponse.

duplication.why: Only downloadFintegraTransactions repeats the per-provider download shape (token, post, error check, response mapping) that Akahu and others already have, following the tree's existing per-provider pattern.

placement.why: Link handler in accounts/app.ts, download and dispatch in accounts/sync.ts, base path in server-config.ts and the account type in types/models, each beside its siblings.

scope.why: Only what the new provider needs plus focused tests (and a mock fix for the existing test's resolved value).

maintainability.why: A thin provider adapter over shared link machinery; the copied download function is the one piece a maintainer would want shared across providers.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Link path goes through assertBankAccountNotLinked and linkAccountAndSync.

disguised_duplication.where: downloadFintegraTransactions is an open, compacted copy of the Akahu download function, not disguised.
